# T-1: Add upgrade artifact contract

## Goal
Define upgrade-result.json version 1, write it during active-flow upgrade execution, and validate raw log paths inside the spec directory.

## Acceptance Criteria
- active flow upgrade writes upgrade-result.json and raw log under the current spec directory
- artifact distinguishes success-no-change, success-updated, and failed
- validator rejects malformed artifact and rawLogPath outside the spec directory
- upgrade entry point accepts only --dry-run, --help, and -h, and rejects positional arguments, value-taking options, and unknown options

## Implementation Notes
Focus on src/upgrade.js and src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js. Keep public upgrade CLI arguments unchanged.

## Test Strategy
Spec tests under specs/278-upgrade-result-artifact/tests/ with // spec: R<N> headers for artifact writer/validator, active-flow upgrade command behavior, and CLI argument validation in a temp repository.
